title: StacheMo's Music Remixes
description: Listen to StacheMo's Minecraft remixes in-game!
body:
# Description
This resource pack adds StacheMo's remixes to Minecraft. 

Check out Stache Mo's channel to listen to them: [Youtube](https://www.youtube.com/@stachemo2886/featured)

## Licensed under CC-BY: 
Please leave credit if using in a social media video or modpack:
(Copy and paste into the description)
```
Featuring music by Stache Mo:
https://www.youtube.com/@stachemo2886/featured

Texture pack used:
https://modrinth.com/project/ZHZ2dycJ
```
## Preview 
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/uYk_-Vq_HdA" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Tracks Included
In the latest version of the texture pack, the following tracks are included:
1. Aria Math
2. Blind Spots
3. Dead Voxel
4. Haggstrom
5. Living Mice
6. Moog City 2
7. Sweden
8. Beginning 2

## Note: Some music is location-specific:
### While in the main menu:
- Moog City 2 
- Beginning 2
  
### While in Creative mode:
- Aria Math
- Blind Spots


### While in the Overworld
- Sweden
- Living Mice (Also in creative)
- Haggstrom (Also in creative)


### While in the Nether:
- Dead Voxel



> **Keep in mind due to the large number of music tracks in the game in general, it may take some time before you hear the remixes. Use a mod like [Music Moods](https://modrinth.com/project/z23qey0b) to skip the silence between tracks.**
